title: Comfort Club Member Install Credit on Replacement System Installations: Posting Rule and Tool Reference
content:
# Member install credit — posting

## Rule

A Comfort Club member whose agreement is in active status on the contract's signing date receives a member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract, posted once as a member install credit naming the contract-price charge.

The member install credit stacks with the manufacturer rebate and the multi-system discount, all three applying to the contract price independently, and it is given once per project.

## Business effect

Posting the credit records one member install credit on the project ledger, naming the project's contract-price charge and the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement, dated the day it is posted. The amount the homeowner owes on the project falls by exactly that credit, and the project's money history shows the member install credit on the contract-price charge.

| Comfort Club agreement on the signing date | Member install credit already on the project | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Active | No | Posted once, naming the contract-price charge |
| Active | Yes | Not posted again |

## Tool: `post_member_install_credit_c2d484b0`

**Capability.** Posts the Comfort Club member install credit on a replacement-installation contract: one credit on the project's ledger for the amount given, naming the contract-price charge it reduces and the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement it is earned under, dated today.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_member_install_credit_c2d484b0` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_id` | The reference number of the installation project being credited, as shown by the installation project lookup for this homeowner | Text identifier |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's customer profile, as shown by the customer profile lookup | Text identifier |
| `agreement_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement the credit is earned under, as shown by the Comfort Club agreement lookup | Text identifier |
| `source_entry_id` | The reference number of the project's contract-price charge entry that the credit reduces, as shown by the installation ledger lookup | Text identifier |
| `amount` | The member install credit | US dollars, a number with no currency sign, 2 decimal places, always positive, already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `install_entry_id` (the new credit entry), `install_id` (the project credited), `source_entry_id` (the contract-price charge the credit names), `amount` (2 decimal places), `posted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `project_balance` (the amount owed once the credit is applied, or null when the project could not be read). A receipt carrying `install_entry_id` means the credit is on the project.
